title: It isn't thick enough to touch my back
text: It isn't thick enough to touch my back. Before I can get my body to touch this pillow I have to push myself so far back in the chair that my feet aren't touching and if I lower the chair any more the desk will be too high.  Just a waste of money.  Why do I do this I really didn't think it would work - it was just a stupid hope.
